entry.title: v0.32.0rc1
entry.content:
v0.32.0rc1 - 2026.11.10

This is the first release candidate of vLLM Ascend v0.32.0, aligned with upstream vLLM v0.32.0. This release introduces support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and adds optimizations for DeepSeek V4.1-Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash. It also improves context parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV Cache management. The hardware and deployment scope below summarizes the configurations documented in each model guide; it does not claim validation for other model and hardware combinations. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

Model Hardware Supported Features
MiniMax-M3.1-Flash A3 Products, 950DT Products W8A8 on A3 and MXFP8 on 950DT; text, image, and video inference; DSpark speculative decoding; single-node and multi-node P/D deployment; KV Cache Pool and text-only 1M-context deployment on A3.
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next A2 Products, A3 Products, 950DT Products W8A8 with MTP speculative decoding; W4A8/W4A8-MXFP deployment configurations; QSA and GDN attention; multimodal inference, function calling, and reasoning parsing; single-node TP8, colocated serving, P/D disaggregation, and MemCache-based KV Cache Pool deployment guides.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A2 Products, A3 Products, 950DT Products W8A8 with DSpark speculative decoding and SWA bounded replay; single-node and multi-node deployments, including P/D disaggregation and KV Cache Pool integration.
GLM-5.3-Flash A2 Products, A3 Products, 950DT Products W8A8 on A2/A3 and W8A8-MXFP8 on 950DT; text, image, and video inference; MTP speculative decoding; single-node and multi-node P/D deployment with KV Cache Pool support.

Highlights

  • MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: Added support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on A3 and 950DT, including W8A8/MXFP8 deployment configurations, single-node and P/D disaggregated inference, native DSpark speculative decoding, and optional FlashAttention-3 execution on A3. Improved MXFP8 MoE quantization correctness, reasoning behavior, and multimodal execution stability. #19723 #20067 #20691 #20120 #20468 #20445 #20935
  • Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: Enabled pipeline and sequence parallelism with correct stage-local QSA/GDN/PLE cache management; optimized long-context prefill attention and reduced CPU synchronization overhead; added PLE embedding sharding and INT8 quantization support; and fixed MTP draft execution and MegaMoE communication issues. #20443 #20467 #20444 #20516 #20548 #20597 #20502
  • GLM-5.3-Flash: Improved PCP correctness and compatibility with torch.compile, including fixes for KPool query alignment, decode replication, and packed KV-cache layouts. Enabled static-kernel compilation, optimized KDA RecoverSSM state updates, and added optional FP8 KeyPool Lightning Indexer cache support. #20473 #20513 #20503 #20524 #20447
  • DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Added Ascend 950DT model execution support, enhanced encoder/decoder SWA bounded replay, and enabled torch.compile for the model backbone. On A3, optimized QuantLightningIndexer (QLI) Top-K merging and vector operations to reduce sorting, data movement, and workspace overhead. #17927 #18081 #17496 #17742 #18936 #20441
  • Attention kernels: Optimized INT8 Quantized Sparse Flash Attention (QSFA) on A2/A3 by eliminating redundant no-RoPE computation, improving sparse KV gathering and address caching, and reducing data movement overhead. Improved SFA correctness and performance on A2/A3 and 950DT by initializing padded TND output rows directly in the kernel and removing redundant per-layer output masking. #20584 #20578
  • KV Cache and Transfer: Improved the correctness and reliability of layerwise MLA KV-cache transfers by synchronizing external KV loading with attention execution and enabling subsequent layer prefetching. Added optional FP8 Lightning Indexer key-cache support for GLM-5.3-Flash CANN KeyPool on 950DT to reduce cache memory consumption. #20477 #20447
  • Quantization and MoE: Added ModelSlim W4A8 dynamic Linear support with INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activation quantization. Improved quantized inference correctness by fixing MXFP packed-store tail masking. Extended MegaMoE support for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 950DT with 2560-dimensional hidden states, corrected communication routing for unquantized MTP drafts, and unified MegaMoE configuration validation across A3 and 950DT. #20507 #20540 #20502 #20506

Features

  • Made Model Runner V2 the default execution path for supported Ascend configurations and expanded compatibility with encoder-only, encoder-decoder, pooling, and hybrid-encoder models. #17681 #19159 #18995 #20710
  • Expanded Model Runner V2 speculative decoding with draft-model execution, block verification, N-gram NPU acceleration, MultiModuleMTPSpeculator support, and Gemma4 MTP compatibility. #19364 #19138 #18061 #19296 #17492
  • Extended DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash context parallelism with SWA bounded replay across PCP and DP configurations, reducing redundant decoder replay computation during long-context prefill. #19321 #20210
  • Added GLM-5.3-Flash KDA RecoverSSM support with recurrent-state verification and recovery, and extended compatibility with prefix caching, PCP, and AscendStore cache reuse. #20128 #20131 #20369 #21059
  • Enabled torch.compile for the GLM-5.3-Flash backbone and MTP draft model, improving compatibility with compiled and graph-based inference execution. #19076
  • Expanded Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with pipeline and sequence parallelism, PLE embedding sharding, INT8 quantization, and optional CPU offloading to improve distributed inference and memory efficiency. #20443 #20516 #20548 #20560
  • Added Ascend-optimized Triton PLE convolution paths for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next prefill, decode, and speculative execution, and optimized QSA indexing and attention preprocessing. #20344 #20642 #21104 #20499 #20699
  • Expanded Mooncake layerwise KV-cache transfer with component-aware cache handling, improving compatibility with hybrid attention, recurrent states, and distributed Prefill-Decode configurations. #20625
  • Extended AscendStore KV Cache Pool with Qwen3.8 hybrid-cache pooling, GLM RecoverSSM prefix reuse, and optional Mooncake SSD-to-DRAM prefetching. #20261 #21059 #19472
  • Added optional Prefill session affinity to improve prefix-cache reuse across multi-turn requests in distributed deployments. #19708
  • Expanded quantization and expert load balancing support with ModelSlim W4A8 Dynamic Linear and EPLB compatibility for W4A8-MXFP and W8A8-MXFP8 MoE models. #20507 #20713 #20847
  • Expanded MiniMax speculative decoding with native DSpark draft support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and FlashAttention execution for compatible MiniMax-M3 draft configurations on Ascend 950DT. #20691 #19537

Performance

  • Improved Qwen3.8-Flash-Next long-context prefill performance by automatically selecting the appropriate attention kernel based on context length, reducing unnecessary computation. #20467
  • Reduced Qwen3.8-Flash-Next CPU-NPU synchronization overhead by eliminating unnecessary token-count transfers and CPU-side updates in supported Model Runner V2 configurations. #20444
  • Optimized Model Runner V2 UVA buffer management to reduce CPU tracking overhead and improve asynchronous memory transfers, accelerating request preparation for long prompts. #20542
  • Optimized DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash QuantLightningIndexer (QLI) on A2/A3 by reducing redundant Top-K sorting, merging, and data movement to improve sparse attention indexing efficiency. #20441
  • Improved INT8 Quantized Sparse Flash Attention (QSFA) performance on A2/A3 by eliminating unnecessary no-RoPE computation and optimizing sparse KV-cache access and data preparation. #20584
  • Improved GLM-5.3-Flash attention correctness and performance on A2/A3 and 950DT by initializing padded outputs directly in the kernel and eliminating redundant output masking. #20578
  • Optimized GLM-5.3-Flash KDA RecoverSSM state updates on 950DT by reducing memory-write overhead and improving recurrent-state processing efficiency. #20524

Dependencies

Use the official v0.32.0rc1 release images to ensure that the required operator packages and matching dependency versions are installed.

  • Upstream vLLM: v0.32.0
  • CANN: 9.2.1
  • PyTorch / torch-npu: 2.10.0 / 2.10.0.post7
  • Triton Ascend: 3.6.0.post2 for A2, A3, and Ascend 950; Triton Ascend is not supported on Atlas 300I DUO.
  • mooncake-transfer-engine-npu: 0.3.14.rc1.
  • flash-linear-attention-npu: v26.9.1-release.
  • memfabric-hybrid / memcache-hybrid: 1.3.0 / 1.3.0.
  • ray: >= 2.47.1, <= 2.48.0.
  • Python: 3.12 (release image base).

Deprecation and Configuration Changes

  • Model Runner V2 is now the default when VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER is unset, with automatic fallback to Model Runner V1 for unsupported configurations. Users can explicitly select Model Runner V1 or V2 by setting VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 or VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1, respectively. #17681
  • Added optional CPU offloading for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next PLE embedding tables through --engram-config to reduce NPU memory usage. Offloading is disabled by default, with automatic fallback to private host memory when cross-node sharing is unavailable. #20560
  • Added optional FP8 and INT8 pooled-indexer KV-cache configurations for GLM-5.3-Flash through attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype, while retaining BF16 as the default. FP8 is supported on 950DT, while INT8 is restricted to A3. #20447 #20601
  • Dynamic chunk size Chunked Pipeline Parallelism (CPP) is deprecated as of v0.32.0 and has entered the sunset process. In modern sparse and linear attention models, dynamic chunking provides negligible benefit while introducing significant scheduling and profiling maintenance overhead. See RFC #21304 for details and migration guidance.
  • Decode Context Parallelism (DCP) for GQA models is deprecated as of v0.32.0 and has entered the sunset process. GQA models naturally shard KV heads across TP ranks and rarely require multi-node KV sharding; in speculative decoding, GQA draft models maintain native TP sharding without requiring DCP. See RFC #21305 for details.

Documentation

  • Added MiniMax-M3.1-Flash deployment guide and support matrix for A3, and Ascend 950DT products, covering W8A8/MXFP8 weights, DSpark speculative decoding, single-node serving, and P/D deployment. #19723
  • Updated DeepSeek V4.1-Flash A2 deployment guidance and removed obsolete MTP deployment examples from the DeepSeek V4-Flash tutorial, retaining the supported DSpark serving configurations. #20292 #20323
  • Added GLM KDA RecoverSSM usage documentation, including A3/950DT configurations, execution-mode limitations, and Mooncake P/D requirements, and updated prefix-caching guidance. Corrected GLM deployment examples for expert parallelism, proxy configuration, and P/D serving. #20134 #20369 #20183
  • Refined Qwen3.5-397B-A17B deployment guidance with corrected MTP checkpoint names, Docker shared-memory settings, and evaluation instructions. Improved AISBench accuracy-evaluation documentation for Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B. #20283 #20170
  • Corrected Kimi K3 mixed and P/D deployment configurations, including explicit Model Runner V2 selection and Ascend 950DT memory-utilization settings. #20379
  • Fixed the Qwen3-30B-A3B tutorial's serving command to use the valid --served-model-name option. #20874

Stability and Bug Fixes

  • Fixed Model Runner V2 speculative decoding issues involving GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemma4, hybrid KV Cache, and PCP graph execution, improving compatibility and execution reliability. #18931 #19264 #19165 #19192
  • Fixed Model Runner V2 KV Cache initialization failures when handling hybrid cache structures containing non-Tensor components. #19598
  • Fixed GLM-5.3-Flash PCP execution and compiled prefill issues, improving correctness in distributed attention and mixed prefill/decode workloads. #20513 #20473
  • Fixed GLM-5.3-Flash RecoverSSM state synchronization and EPLB initialization issues, improving reliability for distributed inference and quantized MoE execution. #20735 #20720
  • Improved Mooncake and KVPP layerwise KV-cache transfer reliability by fixing loading synchronization, stale transfer plans, physical-block tracking, and segmented data transfers. #19484 #19785 #19070 #19273 #20477
  • Improved KV Cache Pool and Mooncake recovery by fixing request preemption handling, transfer-engine initialization failures, scheduler hangs, and incomplete request cleanup. #19693 #19086 #18017 #20605
  • Fixed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash MLA metadata preparation and quantized projection weight-loading issues, improving compatibility with asynchronous attention execution and MXFP8/INT8 configurations. #20518 #20689
  • Fixed MLA prefill correctness issues involving RoPE padding and KV-cache reads, and prevented C8 quantization-scale corruption during KV-cache transfers. #18798 #19064
  • Fixed compilation and graph initialization issues involving BF16 SwiGLU, GBSA static-kernel selection, and cached graph loading, improving compatibility with Triton Ascend 3.6.0. #19519 #19317 #19177
  • Fixed attention kernel execution issues involving QSFA static kernels, non-Triton RoPE compatibility, and Qwen PLE prefill compilation on supported Ascend hardware. #20662 #20770 #20680
  • Fixed shared KV Cache memory allocation and Mamba prefix-cache consistency issues across Step-3.5/3.7, GLM-Next, and hybrid recurrent-attention models. #19558 #19457 #20942
  • Improved MoE and EPLB stability by fixing expert-weight transfers, routing consistency, worker initialization, and communication selection under pipeline parallelism. #18425 #18502 #18878 #19073 #20711 #20490
  • Fixed MegaMoE configuration validation and MiniMax FlashAttention-3 initialization issues, improving compatibility and startup reliability across supported Ascend configurations. #20506 #20935

Known Issues

  • In v0.32.0rc1, Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct fails to initialize because CANN/OPP has no supported Conv2D kernel for its audio processing path. #21487
  • In A3 pooling P/D deployments with GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8, prolonged stress tests may hit a RecoverSSM speculative metadata staging error that terminates the D-node EngineCore and stalls the service; the root cause is unconfirmed. #21486
  • On 950DT, D-node throughput for GLM-5.3-Flash pooling P/D workloads with multiple prefixes can be up to approximately 50% lower than in v0.30.0; the root cause is under investigation. #21485

entry.title: v0.30.0
entry.content:
v0.30.0 - 2026.10.29

This is the stable release of vLLM Ascend v0.30.0, built on the v0.29 release line and aligned with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline. Building on v0.30.0rc1, this release integrates FlashMLA decode with DCP and DSpark, extends KV Pool layerwise pooling and PCP speculative decoding, hardens EPLB for the new quantization formats, and fixes the stability issues across attention, MoE, KV transfer, and Model Runner V2 execution reported during the RC cycle. It still focuses on the flagship models: DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-27B, DeepSeek V4-Flash/Pro, Kimi K3. Model or hardware combinations outside the scope declared in v0.30.0 are not part of the release claims. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

PR references marked with † were merged into the v0.30.0 release branch before v0.30.0rc1.

Notice: In this version, modelrunner still defaults to v1, but some models require v2 to be enabled for support. For specific information, please refer to the model tutorial. We plan to fully switch to Model Runner V2 in the next version.

Highlights

  • DeepSeek V4.1: Added DeepSeek V4.1 support on Model Runner V2, enabled torch.compile, and sped up startup via in-place rotary embedding, reused filtered RoPE lookups, and removed redundant DSV4.1 indexer/SP copies; added the TurboQuant 4-bit latent KV cache for DSA sparse models (DeepSeek V4 Flash; A2/A3 only), including packed KV cache in the V1 runner; fixed ModelSlim-quantized DSV4 weight layout and added AscendStore preparation for V4.1, and packaged attention operators (QLI/QSLI/MQSMLA) with DSL. #17927 #16899 #17726 #17676 #18026 #18081 #16548 #16978 #17067 #17165 #17483 #16973†
  • GLM-5.3: Enabled sparse SFA C8 (INT8 packed KV cache) for GLM-5.3-Flash and indexer MXFP4 for GLM-5.2, added the TurboQuant 4-bit latent KV cache for GLM-5.2/5.3 SFA (A2/A3 only), fixed GLM MRV2 issues and GLM-5.2 DSpark sequence lengths/per-request FIA bounds, fixed GLM-5.3-Flash small slot page inflation, and backported always-on reasoning for GLM-5.3. #17115 #17949 #18060 #17613 #17571 #17545 #17876†
  • GLM-5.3-Flash: Added KV Pool support for non-layerwise pooling and Mamba in Mooncake layerwise, added layerwise memcache DRAM/SSD pooling, optimized Triton KPool and gated norm, supported GQA decode context parallelism and SFA-only DSA CP, and provided P/D and KV cache pool deployment guides. #16945 #17287 #17698 #17542 #16478 #17990 #17987 #17773 #17946†
  • Qwen3.8-27B: Supported non-contiguous KV cache in hybrid linear-attention models, respected per-layer KV cache dtype and kept KV cache contiguous for paged attention, restored C8 V scales on hybrid cache page reassignment, restored Mamba block tables before deferred PP postprocessing, added the FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill, and fixed 310P performance and kernel compatibility for quantized deployment. #14340 #17924 #18003 #17956 #17954 #17565 #17534 #16420 #17964 #17278†
  • Kimi K3 on Ascend: Added end-to-end Kimi K3 support, including MLA DSpark speculative decoding, no-RoPE MLAPO on Ascend 950, fused QKV projections, fused norm gate and attention residual, EPLB, MegaMoE, and projector rotation. #12950 #13277 #13507 #13989 #13509 #14231†
  • GLM-5.2 / DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 / DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 accuracy and performance: Resolved GLM-5.2 DSpark acceptance regressions and DeepSeek V4 Flash-0731 / Pro-0813 accuracy issues (reasoning-effort alignment, routed SwiGLU limit, and frontend behavior), and reused DSV4 compressor metadata across layers for better performance. #12262 #13531 #13993 #14074 #14397 #14624 #14994†
  • Deprecation cleanup: Removed layer sharding, FlashComm2, multistream overlap gate, dynamic-batch SLO, weight prefetch, matmul all-reduce fusions, and kv offload in KV Pool to streamline the codebase. #11953 #12117 #11956 #11933 #11949 #12119 #11904†
  • FlashMLA decode: Integrated FlashMLA decode with DCP and DSpark, routed strided MLA cache writes through PROLOG_V3, used native GatherPa for strided MLA cache reads, enabled no-RoPE MLAPO for token-fused FlashMLA, and skipped FlashMLA CPU length synchronization under DCP. #18758 #18682 #19151 #19155 #19115 #19038
  • KV Pool: Added global layer-window prefetch for layerwise loads, GLM-5.3-Flash Mooncake layerwise support, and Triton KeyPool cache adapters; supported packed SFA C8 layerwise transfer, and reduced lookup/reachable-mask and page-table overhead. #18975 #18749 #18296 #18716 #18837 #18576 #18245
  • MoE: Backported Kimi K3 MegaMoE routed dimensions, integrated the mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla operator for the DeepSeek-V4 FP8 KV path, fused shared W8A8 MXFP activation quantization, and used BF16 router GEMM with FP32 accumulation. #18976 #18808 #18678 #18820
  • PCP & speculative decoding: Supported PCP with PIECEWISE and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs, fixed-K speculative decode request sharding in PCP, and speculative decoding in KVPP. #18365 #18312 #18334
  • EPLB: Supported Kimi K3 and its MTP draft model and w8a8_mxfp8 on A5, and hardened staging-buffer fencing, HIXL registration ranges, and expert weight updates. #18261 #18436 #19098 #18415 #18458 #18564

Features

  • Integrated FlashMLA decode with DCP and DSpark, and routed strided MLA cache writes through PROLOG_V3. #18758 #18682
  • Enabled no-RoPE MLAPO for token-fused FlashMLA and integrated the mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla operator for the DeepSeek-V4 FP8 KV path. #19155 #18808
  • Supported C8 MXFP8 KV cache in the V2 worker, and supported A5 SFA C8 decode context parallelism. #18707 #18321
  • Added KV Pool global layer-window prefetch for layerwise loads and Triton KeyPool cache adapters. #18975 #18296
  • Backported GLM-5.3-Flash Mooncake layerwise support and packed SFA C8 layerwise transfer. #18749 #18716
  • Backported Kimi K3 MegaMoE routed dimensions and CANN pooled indexing for GLM-5.3-Flash. #18976 #18289
  • Supported PCP with PIECEWISE and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs and fixed-K speculative decode request sharding in PCP. #18365 #18312
  • Supported speculative decoding and MultiConnector in KVPP. #18334 #18633
  • Supported EPLB for Kimi K3 and its MTP draft model, and w8a8_mxfp8 EPLB on A5. #18261 #18436
  • Added direct msprobe dump support to Model Runner V2, and a greater-than-or-equal-to (ge) accuracy verification mode for benchmarking. #18557 #18412

Hardware and Operator Support

  • Supported C8 MXFP8 KV cache in the V2 worker and the mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla operator for the DeepSeek-V4 FP8 KV path. #18707 #18808
  • Backported CANN pooled indexing for GLM-5.3-Flash. #18289
  • Included SparseFlashAttention in A5 custom kernel builds and packaged shared headers for standalone kernel compilation. #18310 #18693
  • Used memory copy for expert weight updates on Ascend 950 in EPLB. #19043

Performance

  • Used native GatherPa for strided MLA cache reads, and skipped FlashMLA CPU length synchronization with DCP and in audited speculative decoding. #19151 #19115 #19038
  • Preserved the GLM V1 SP token layout through PP and DSA-CP. #18929 #18671
  • Reduced KV Pool lookup and reachable-mask overhead, cached layer-invariant masked block runs across layers, and skipped invisible KPool page-table loads. #18837 #18245 #18576
  • Used BF16 router GEMM with FP32 accumulation and fused shared W8A8 MXFP activation quantization in MoE. #18820 #18678
  • Enabled fused MiniMax sparse prepare through 256K tokens and fused MiniMax-M3 A3 index TopK helpers. #18660 #18323
  • Reduced QKV layout copies for FLA attention, and offloaded Qwen3.5-VL image preprocessing to the NPU. #18727 #18443
  • Used activation exchange for PCP decode O projection in DSA, and optimized the hc_pre kernels. #18537 #18347

Dependencies

  • Upstream vLLM: v0.30.0.
  • CANN: 9.2.1.
  • PyTorch / torch_npu: 2.10.0 / 2.10.0.post7.
  • Triton Ascend: 3.6.0.post2 for A2, A3, and Ascend 950; Triton Ascend is not supported on Atlas 300I DUO.
  • mooncake-transfer-engine-npu: 0.3.14-rc1.
  • flash-linear-attention-npu: v26.9.1-release.
  • memfabric-hybrid / memcache-hybrid: 1.3.0 / 1.3.0.
  • ray: >= 2.47.1, <= 2.48.0.
  • Python: 3.12 (release image base).

Deprecation and Configuration Changes

  • MRV1 will follow the upstream and be removed in the next version. Meanwhile, some external interfaces that are only compatible with MRV1 will also be deprecated. For specific details, please refer to Additional Configuration Doc.
  • Reverted the A3 GMM dequant SiTU quant fusion. #18927
  • Removed the StoreKVBlock optimization and the c8_enable_reshape_optim switch, and removed redundant sparse KV offload configs. #18301 #18271
  • Disabled torch.compile for eager draft models in speculative decoding. #18487
  • Due to the gradual decline in usage of some old models, and considering maintenance costs, we will gradually sunset these old models. For specific information, please refer to the Support Models Doc.

Documentation

  • Updated model deployment guides: GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash deployment/evaluation and A2 PD configuration, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A2 PD and KV Cache Pool, DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant serving options and KV cache options, MiniMax-M3 deployment, tuning, and 1M PD deployment, Kimi-K3 guide migration, Gemma4 quantized deployment, and SigLIP2 tutorial paths. #18275 #18358 #18829 #18880 #18588 #18530 #18430 #18661 #18574 #18581 #18453 #19121 #18463 #18835 #18690 #18480
  • Documented platform features: PCP execution and DCP integration, KVPP supported combinations, the Fine-grained TP guide, MooncakeConnectorV2 features and deployment, Mooncake timeout tuning, Atlas 850/850E/950 SuperPod PD configuration, Qwen3.5 batch invariance, TurboQuant context-parallelism limitation, hardware and redundant expert constraints, sparse KV offload, and DeepSeek V4.1 Memcache pooling. #18856 #18737 #18702 #18778 #18409 #18562 #18455 #18177 #18570 #18937 #18888 #19014 #18342
  • Clarified GLM-5 discontinuation and GLM-5.1 deployment examples, corrected the Ascend HDK and image versions, removed the jemalloc usage guidance, and updated documentation versions and translations. #18553 #18467 #18380 #18414 #18681 #18925 #18563 #18482 #19018

Stability and Bug Fixes

  • Fixed MRV2 and compilation: initialized the static kernel runtime from the compiler config before loading cached graphs, skipped incompatible kernels for static kernels, inferred local workers for external DP static kernels, preserved graph eligibility on P/D decode nodes, and shrank the 310P rejection sampler host buffer. #19246 #19178 #18885 #18725 #18309 #18995
  • Fixed attention and MLA: sized o_proj static exchange buffers from decode capacity, fixed MLA PROLOG_V3 tile sizes for non-128 KV pages, bounded MLA prefill npu_attention_update inputs with 16-way staged merging, fixed MXFP8 KV-scale corruption during PD transfers, fixed DCP FIA workspace ownership, backported FIA v2 for DCP MLA decode, synced the mla_preprocess tile traversal with tiling swizzle, avoided the KvQuantSFA operator for models that do not require LSE, and supported dense sequence parallelism for the Qwen3.5 family. #19263 #19214 #19013 #19017 #18768 #18752 #18687 #18550 #19001
  • Fixed MoE and quantization: fixed CANN MegaMoE weight preparation for DeepSeek V4 W4A8 MXFP, preserved the quantized shared expert output gate, restored non-EPLB W8A8 MXFP8 NZ tensors, removed the W8A8 MXFP8 local expert count assertion, and preserved MiniMax-M3 prequantized shared Down input. #19199 #18895 #18788 #18718 #18397
  • Fixed EPLB: fenced staging-buffer reuse before HIXL READs, fixed HIXL registration ranges and resource cleanup, backported NZ Gloo receive staging, used W8A8 MXFP per-expert list weights, fixed W4A8 MXFP EPLB runtime, fixed dynamic EPLB startup in headless workers, and synchronized the NPU in sleep and wakeup. #19098 #18415 #18458 #18686 #18444 #18564 #18338
  • Fixed KV Pool and KV transfer: preserved physical blocks in bulk and layerwise cache transfers, isolated Memcache transfer failures and recovered ordinary layerwise transfer failures, backported synchronous Mamba state-copy ordering, ensured full range load when prefill layerwise offload is enabled, dropped the save-side GVA cache on idempotent batch_alloc, handled MemCache allocation sentinel values, requested huge pages before Engram host registration, required full page coverage for Mooncake merging, fixed Mooncake V2 scheduler resource cleanup, kept AscendStore receive registration until completion, and supported mixed C8 and BF16 layers for layerwise reuse in prefill offload. #19069 #19090 #18813 #19060 #18905 #18379 #18544 #18637 #18748 #18957 #18424 #18298
  • Fixed PCP and parallel execution: cleared DeepSeek V4.1 query metadata on empty ranks, clamped invalid slots before cache address computation, supported multimodal inputs for DeepSeek V4.1 in PCP, fixed CPP profiling dummy prefill routing with PCP, and fixed GLM-5.3-Flash OProj TP with ragged DP decoding. #18877 #18398 #18282 #18669 #18889
  • Fixed speculative decoding and models: restored independent RNG for residual resampling, fixed PP MTP token validation API compatibility, resynced DP to avoid unreasonable padding in adaptive verification, backported Kimi A5 draft KV cache and FP8 MLA output fixes, used grouped matmul for eager MXFP8 projections in Kimi, preserved the Kimi K3 draft checkpoint LM head, skipped the Eagle3 PP aux patch for MiniMax-M3, patched the MiniMax-M3 fused all-reduce norm on vLLM's real module, kept MiniMax-M3 sparse attention outside piecewise graphs, aligned GLM-5.3-Flash video placeholder timestamps with pixel-path frame sampling, matched KDA fallback compiled launches to Triton signatures, and guarded DeepSeek buffer mutation. #18658 #18629 #18250 #18897 #18756 #19066 #18370 #18548 #18979 #18866 #18840 #18429
  • Hardened infrastructure: fixed the shared memory broadcast buffer race with failure diagnostics, fixed custom AICPU aggregation, serialized csrc publication directory creation, fixed the 310P Qwen3.5-2B-w8a8 performance issue, and validated DeepSeek V4 tensor parallel limits. #18134 #18393 #18924 #18400 #19203

Known Issues

  • We still use MRV1 by default in this version, and some models need to be switched to MRV2 for support. For specific information, please refer to the model tutorial. The main branch has been switched to use MRV2 by default.
  • Gemma-4-E4B-it model fail because of attention op issue. #19559
  • KV pooling with mooncake backend doesn't support SSD offload case on RoCE networking, because kvcache-al/Mooncake#4756 was not merged into current Mooncake version. #19707
  • When layerwise KV pooling with mooncake backend and SSD offload + pipeline parallel, we can't hit kvcache on SSD because of kvcache-al/Mooncake#3658, and the bugfix pr kvcache-al/Mooncake#3916 was not merged into current Mooncake version. #20151
  • When enabling structured output, GLM5.3 model's output can't be aligned with vLLM v0.30.0, because vllm-project/vllm#56994 was not merged into vLLM v0.30.0, and it will be aligned with vLLM in the next version. #20173
  • Some w4 quantifications weights(published by Eco-Tech, like GLM-5.3-w4a4c8-mxfp4, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-w4a8-mxfp) are slightly lower than the accuracy reported in the paper on certain datasets. If these weights are to be used, please conduct accuracy verification and ensure that the accuracy is acceptable.
  • There is a known security issue CVE-2026-114053 about vLLM upstream between v0.7.3 and v0.31.0, and vLLM has resolved this issue in main branch by vllm-project/vllm#58830. Please pay attention to whether your scene will be affected.

entry.title: v0.30.0rc1
entry.content:
v0.30.0rc1 - 2026.10.12

This is vLLM Ascend v0.30.0rc1, a model-focused release built on the v0.29 release line and aligned with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline. This release focuses on four flagship models: DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, and Qwen3.8-27B, and hardens the shared execution stacks they rely on (Model Runner V2, PCP/DCP parallelism, KV Cache Pool, and speculative decoding). Model or hardware combinations outside the scope declared below are not part of the release claims. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

Highlights

  • DeepSeek V4.1: Added DeepSeek V4.1 support on Model Runner V2, enabled torch.compile, and sped up startup via in-place rotary embedding, reused filtered RoPE lookups, and removed redundant DSV4.1 indexer/SP copies; added the TurboQuant 4-bit latent KV cache for DSA sparse models (DeepSeek V4 Flash; A2/A3 only), including packed KV cache in the V1 runner; fixed ModelSlim-quantized DSV4 weight layout and added AscendStore preparation for V4.1, and packaged attention operators (QLI/QSLI/MQSMLA) with DSL. #17927 #16899 #17726 #17676 #18026 #18081 #16548 #16978 #17067 #17165 #17483 #16973
  • GLM-5.3: Enabled sparse SFA C8 (INT8 packed KV cache) for GLM-5.3-Flash and indexer MXFP4 for GLM-5.2, added the TurboQuant 4-bit latent KV cache for GLM-5.2/5.3 SFA (A2/A3 only), fixed GLM MRV2 issues and GLM-5.2 DSpark sequence lengths/per-request FIA bounds, fixed GLM-5.3-Flash small slot page inflation, and backported always-on reasoning for GLM-5.3. #17115 #17949 #18060 #17613 #17571 #17545 #17876
  • GLM-5.3-Flash: Added KV Pool support for non-layerwise pooling and Mamba in Mooncake layerwise, added layerwise memcache DRAM/SSD pooling, optimized Triton KPool and gated norm, supported GQA decode context parallelism and SFA-only DSA CP, and provided P/D and KV cache pool deployment guides. #16945 #17287 #17698 #17542 #16478 #17990 #17987 #17773 #17946
  • Qwen3.8-27B: Supported non-contiguous KV cache in hybrid linear-attention models, respected per-layer KV cache dtype and kept KV cache contiguous for paged attention, restored C8 V scales on hybrid cache page reassignment, restored Mamba block tables before deferred PP postprocessing, added the FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill, and fixed 310P performance and kernel compatibility for quantized deployment. #14340 #17924 #18003 #17956 #17954 #17565 #17534 #16420 #17964 #17278
  • Platform & Execution: Aligned the plugin with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline, extended Model Runner V2 with fine-grained TP (MLP, embedding, o_proj in graph mode) and async CPP scheduling (default-on was evaluated and rolled back pending further hardening), landed the EPLB STAIR placement policy, enhanced PCP (sharded embedding/LM head and O projection weights, PCP+DCP stacking, graph-executed decode sharding). #16527 #17361 #16967 #17380 #17661 #17514 #17512 #17511 #17509 #17510 #17508 #17159 #17502 #17598 #17456 #17958 #17940 #18065 #17112 #17150 #17157

Features

  • Added DeepSeek V4.1 support on Model Runner V2, with AscendStore preparation for V4.1. #16899 #16973
  • Extended Model Runner V2 with fine-grained TP (MLP, embedding, o_proj in graph mode) and async CPP scheduling. #17361 #16967 #17380
  • Added the TurboQuant 4-bit latent KV cache for SFA (GLM-5.2/5.3) and DSA (DeepSeek V4 Flash; A2/A3 only) and extended the packed KV cache to the V1 runner; added DeepSeek V4.1 PCP support, GQA PCP and DCP stacking, and graph execution for sharded decode requests in PCP. #18048 #17992 #18066 #18196
  • Enabled sparse SFA C8 (INT8 packed KV cache) for GLM-5.3-Flash, and supported C8-MXFP (FP8 KV cache with E8M0 scales) and INT8 C8 RoPE0 on A2/A3. #17180 #16706
  • Added KV Pool support for GLM-5.3-Flash non-layerwise pooling and Mamba in Mooncake layerwise, plus layerwise memcache DRAM/SSD pooling. #16945 #17287 #17698
  • Added MooncakeConnectorV2 for P/D disaggregation, enabling MultiConnector combinations with AscendStoreConnector and MemCache KV pooling, with PCP support and KV receive failure handling. #14068 #17355 #18146
  • Supported GQA decode context parallelism and SFA-only DSA CP for GLM-5.3-Flash. #17990 #17987
  • Supported non-contiguous KV cache in hybrid linear-attention models like Qwen3.5, and non-uniform KV cache page sizes in the worker. #14340 #17924 #16966
  • Added flash-linear-attention-npu to Docker images as the FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill. #17534 #16420
  • Added GLM-5.2 V2 sparse KV offload with PP and DSpark, plus fused operators for sparse KV cache offloading. #17900 #17444 #16640 #17392
  • Added KVPP PCP pooling with PIECEWISE execution and reused MTP cache exclusion for DSpark. #17112 #17119
  • Added grouped matmul SiTU quant fusion and integrated A3 GMM dequant SiTU quant fusion in MoE. #17364 #16655
  • Added HIXL expert-weight transfers for EPLB and enabled ACL graph mode for GLM-Next MTP draft models. #17578 #17178
  • Additional feature enhancements: value normalization for split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope (Gemma4), optional MiniMax-M3 prefill KV-gather-Q, Top-K transport across PP stages, batch-sharded sampling, mapped pinned CPU views for MRV2 UVA buffers aligned with draft LM head TP, FullAttn TP parallelism when DCP > 1 in P/D deployment, physical KV block size for DFlash DCP slots, unified MLA prolog connected with DCP current KV, MemCache-backed L1 encoder cache for EC Transfer, and probabilistic draft sampling with MRV2 PCP. #15332 #17241 #15614 #15011 #17680 #15079 #17524 #17717 #17615 #16953 #18086

Hardware and Operator Support

Model Hardware supported in this release Release scope
DeepSeek V4.1 Atlas 800I A3, Atlas 800I A2 W8A8 serving; Model Runner V2 execution, torch.compile, P/D deployment
GLM-5.3 Atlas 800I A3 (128GB x 8), Atlas 800I A2 W8A8C8 multi-node serving; sparse SFA C8 packed KV cache, TurboQuant 4-bit KV cache, speculative decoding (DSpark)
GLM-5.3-Flash Atlas 800I A3 (128GB x 8), Atlas 800I A2 W8A8 on A3/A2; P/D disaggregation and KV Cache Pool deployment
Qwen3.8-27B Atlas 800I A3, Atlas 800I A2, Atlas 300I DUO (W8A8-310P) BF16 and W8A8; hybrid linear-attention serving with non-contiguous KV cache

Performance

Unless stated otherwise, these optimizations are selected automatically for the targeted path and need no additional configuration.

  • Added the FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill, avoided AiCPU fallback for GDN boolean token sorting, reused transposed gate across GDN chunk forward kernels, and skipped unused device metadata copies for GDN fused prefill. #16420 #17219 #17339 #16887
  • Fused SFA hot paths: K-path fused ops with PROLOG_V3 fused decode for non-PD serving, Q up-projection layout transform with npu_transpose_batchmatmul, and reused device cache-store dispatch for SFA C8. #16328 #16198 #17135
  • Fused GLM-5.3-Flash KDA decode output writeback, optimized convolution state copies, Triton KPool and gated norm, and adapted ROW_BLOCK_SIZE in triton_q_rms for better RMSNorm performance. #17011 #17010 #17542 #16478
  • Improved MoE serving: shared expert multistream overlap, zero-block cat padding for shared-expert token pads and MoE prepare, bf16 router GEMM with fp32 accumulation, and released dead W8A8 fp32 MoE scales under MegaMoe. #18122 #17577 #16343 #17068 #17105
  • Optimized the DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant framework path by sharing transform tensors, caching KV plans, and fusing scale correction and cache packing; enabled torch.compile for DeepSeek V4.1. #18037 #18127 #18081
  • Reduced Model Runner V2 overhead: fixed and optimized sampling mask packing, improved dflash_prepare_inputs, avoided redundant resample JIT variants in Triton, and avoided request-count specialization in DSA-CP metadata with fused slot mapping to reduce recompilation. #17193 #15314 #17575 #17346 #17353
  • Reduced KV Pool and AscendStore overhead: deduplicated per-step memcache RPCs, cached layerwise hit checks, and reduced PP save synchronization and SchedulerOutput deepcopy overhead. #16947 #15636
  • Improved PCP/DCP execution: generalized DCP output pack and combine, limited PCP embedding exchange to the local token span, and restored selective eager DP padding with graph safety. #17387 #17561 #16823
  • Improved 310P and quantized deployment performance: FP16 gate projection for MoE routing, a Qwen3.5-2B performance fix, and a 64-token kernel minimum for MiniMax-M3 FP8 KV. #17669 #17278 #18125 #18132
  • Prepared Triton prefill state-copy plans for KDA, widened Mamba temporal postprocess state copies, and skipped repeated MRV2 idle-DP indexer work for MiniMax-M3. #17614 #17260 #17538
  • Added fastokens to Docker images to reduce prefill tokenization CPU overhead (enable with VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=1), and removed NoPE output masking in SFA. #15351 #16896
  • Additional performance improvements: optimized DeepSeek-V4 VL embed_input_ids to remove per-step copies, accepted optional group_index in the dequant_situ_quant BF16 path, and narrowed the KV save fence to requests with released blocks. #16671 #17570 #17555 #18094

Dependencies

  • vLLM: v0.30.0
  • CANN: 9.2.0
  • Ascend HDK: 26.1.1
  • PyTorch / torch_npu: 2.10.0 / 2.10.0.post4
  • Triton Ascend: 3.2.2
  • mooncake-transfer-engine-npu: 0.3.11.post1
  • flash-linear-attention-npu: v26.9.1-beta2
  • ray: >= 2.47.1, <= 2.48.0
  • Python: 3.12 (release image base)

Deprecation and Configuration Changes

  • Bundled KDA operators (causal conv, GDN state, gate cumsum) are replaced by the external flash-linear-attention-npu (fla_npu) package. #17664 #17727
  • Custom operators conflicting with official CANN operator names are renamed with a _vllm suffix (KDA gate cumsum, GDN FwdH, sparse attention, quant lightning indexer) to avoid runtime name collisions; environments should install the corresponding operator packages. #17998 #17997 #17937 #17209
  • MLA preprocess migrates to the ACLNN two-stage interface for NPU Graph. #15182
  • Removed the store_kv_block optimization and the c8_enable_reshape_optim switch. #18128
  • Unified the KV cache quantization dtype configuration through the --kv-quant-dtype parameter. #15514

Documentation

  • Added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash A3 PD deployment guide and documented the W4A4C8 quantization scheme for DSV4-Flash/Pro and GLM-5.2. #17099 #17226
  • Added GLM-5.3-Flash PD / KV cache pool deployment guide and GLM-5.3-Flash A2 PD deployment guide. #17773 #17946
  • Added GLM-5.3 PP PD and MemCache pooling deployment guide. #18169
  • Documented MRV2 feature stacks supported with pipeline parallelism and rewrote the KV pool guide on a unified feature doc template. #17449 #16856
  • Updated the PCP feature compatibility table and documented serving and runtime LoRA updates. #18050 #17802 #18104
  • Updated the KV pool format documentation. #17473

Stability and Bug Fixes

  • Fixed GLM MRV2 issues, GLM-5.2 DSpark sequence lengths and per-request FIA bounds, GLM-5.3-Flash small slot page inflation, and GLM C8 with custom speculative models; preserved packed C8 KPool hybrid block alignment and the first packed causal convolution state, and derived GLM-5.3-Flash SMLA plans from actual sparse indices. #17613 #17571 #17545 #17919 #17922 #17828 #18283
  • Fixed DSA CP and DSpark execution: FULL graph replay metadata, SAS metadata alignment with shared visible KV, MLA DCP DSpark draft metadata, draft token mapping for full-vocabulary DSpark models, DSpark backends without TurboQuant, and DSA block size as a Triton constexpr object. #17750 #17911 #18182 #18184 #18183 #18185 #17580 #18079 #18080
  • Fixed MRV2 P/D disaggregation: register_kv_caches first-tensor-only bug, recompute-scheduler skip of prepare_prefill_inputs, preempt offloading with multi-D2H mamba align resume index, hybrid cache views in preempt offload, and aligned the P/D recompute scheduler with main2main. #17522 #17445 #16729 #18140 #18141 #17672
  • Fixed speculative decoding: corrected rejected token seq_lens in MRV1 and preserved tensor state when skipping drafts, fixed DFlash2 eager metadata, QuaRot weight alignment, hybrid DFlash K/V pages, and DFlash query buffers for ACL graph padding, capped Ascend V2 parallel-draft dummy requests, preserved replicated draft dummy metadata during graph capture, fixed speculative PP CPU token counts for FIA, avoided CPP validation when building PP=1 draft configs, and dropped MRv1 routed-experts capture while keeping MRV2 startable. #14883 #17274 #17772 #17683 #17379 #17746 #17675 #17747 #17381 #17315
  • Fixed PCP and parallel-draft execution: empty MLA PCP prefill ranks, SFA O-projection gathers for short prefills, EPLB for PCP-only replicated drafts with corrected NZ flag for MoE gate weights, preserved PIECEWISE dummy query widths with DP and MTP, and reused upstream PCP speculative and dummy batch handling. #17972 #17947 #17959 #17627 #18038 #18108 #18195 #18194 #17632
  • Fixed KV Pool: layerwise cache group indexing under PP, layerwise state prep and allocation rounding, synchronized MemCache initialization, and skipped SSD offload registration for scheduler-only Mooncake clients. #17246 #17487 #17289 #18238
  • Fixed Mooncake transfers: empty receives with decode-only DCP, truncated hybrid prefill before prefix-cache lookup, MooncakeConnectorV1 combined attention cache normalization, and reset request-level states in sparse KV offload. #17497 #17407 #17867 #17708
  • Restored hybrid KV cache capacity on 310P by sharing Mamba group slots, fixed LoRA in graph mode on 310P and opened MRV2 LoRA, and fixed 310P kernel block sizes to stay compatible with physical KV cache blocks. #17416 #16457 #17964
  • Preserved SFA and indexer cache writes across device adaptors, aligned DP-padded SFA inputs with attention metadata, rebuilt the sparse MLA plan from passed indices for MTP drafts, refreshed MLA/SFA runtime weights in place on reload, and preserved PCP decode ownership and KV-copy kernel reuse in SFA. #17594 #16768 #17535 #16717 #18266
  • Fixed MoE quantization and EPLB: released requantized W4A4 MXFP4 activations before GMM1, resolved MoE communication methods with MoE config, supported SiTU and MRV2 in MegaMoe, fixed E8M0 scale dtype and missing activation kwargs for CANN MegaMoE, and preserved NPU format for expert buffers in EPLB. #16968 #17916 #18024 #17587 #18157 #18137 #18015
  • Improved hybrid cache handling: respected per-layer KV cache dtype and kept KV cache contiguous for paged attention, restored C8 V scales on hybrid cache page reassignment, restored Mamba block tables before deferred PP postprocessing while avoiding full recurrent-state copies, and normalized GQA tuples with registered strided cache spans in KV cache. #18003 #17924 #17956 #17954 #17565 #18062 #17934
  • Hardened distributed communication: kept a dedicated 1 MiB HCCL lifecycle anchor in sleep mode, destroyed native HCCL communicators on weight-transfer shutdown, selected local communication endpoints by bound NPU, and pinned EC cache load device to the correct NPU index in TP>1. #15340 #17154 #16249 #18291
  • Fixed DeepSeek V4 and MLA handling: restored platform-default indexer KV dtype, initialized V4 IndexCache at the first C4 of each PP stage, applied DeepSeek-V4 attention sinks through the weight loader, fixed MXFP8 O-proj TP and MRV2 DSACP serving, and honored interleaved RoPE in AscendApplyRotaryEmb. #17635 #17921 #16958 #17961 #17825
  • Fixed core serving paths: preserved private cache groups with prefix caching disabled, supported encoder-decoder model state on MRV2, zeroed static KV buffers after cudagraph capture, rejected legacy DSA-CP with Model Runner V2, avoided ConstraintViolationError under torch.compile in vocab parallel embedding, made non-PA FIA key and value contiguous, fixed scatter_nd_update_sk silent row loss for non-contiguous inputs with block-strided KV cache support in the transpose operator, and preserved decode graphs for hybrid PD recompute tails. #17569 #17979 #18044 #18263 #17659 #18210 #18206 #17903 #17925 #17647 #17868 #18152
  • Additional fixes: fixed Engram BF16 checkpoints without implicit quantization, HOST_UVA page migration during CPU binding, same-node external DP launches, and Engram history and lookup timing in Model Runner V2 with multi-node DP node-local head sharding; avoided a current-config lookup in MiniMax-M3 MRV2 forward, passed worldSize explicitly to dispatch_ffn_combine ops and constexpr args to the KDA compiled launcher, marked tilingData as const in CompressorMetadataKernel, updated the online calibration model linear term in CPP, removed a leftover debug log in QSFA tiling, and pointed users at the recipe fix when o_proj capacity is exceeded. #17513 #17348 #17248 #17794 #18052 #17427 #17994 #17914 #17913 #17463 #18303 #18110 #18272 #18126

Known Issues

  • Default Model Runner V2 for all configurations was reverted; MRV2 remains opt-in per configuration. #17661
  • MRV1 dirty block-table optimization was reverted on the release line. #17470
  • The resolved prefix retention config propagation was reverted. #18029
  • See the issue tracker for open accuracy investigations on DSV4.1 + DSA-CP (#17729) and GLM-5.3 P/D (#17541).

entry.title: v0.27.1rc1
entry.content:
v0.27.1rc1 - 2026.09.24

This is the first release candidate of v0.27.1 for vLLM Ascend, aligned with upstream vLLM v0.27.1. This model-focused release adds MiniMax-M3 support on Atlas 800 A3 and 950DT Products, and new DeepSeek-V4-Flash support on 950DT Products. Other models and hardware combinations, such as Atlas 800 A2, were not sufficiently validated for this release. Models and hardware combinations outside this declared scope are not part of the v0.27.1rc1 release claim. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

Highlights

  • MiniMax-M3 on Atlas 800 A3 and 950DT Products: Added BF16, W8A8, and ModelOpt-compatible MXFP8 serving paths, with optimized MSA index-score, top-k, FlashDecoding, tensor-parallel communication, and the 950DT Products FP8 sparse-attention path. #14412 #14539 #13142 #13987 #15897 #15926
  • DeepSeek-V4-Flash on 950DT Products: Added the validated DSpark serving path, including DSpark integration with DSA-CP and SparseFlashMla-based BF16 KV sparse attention. Eligible compressor, indexer, sparse-attention, DSpark, and local DSA-CP metadata is built asynchronously on Model Runner V1. #13249 #13506 #13716 #15776
  • Speculative-decoding and serving stability: Hardened sequence-length boundaries, empty-context handling, draft-state publication, rejection sampling, request token validation, and distributed MemCache initialization. #16513 #16720 #17276 #16215 #16161 #17308

Features

  • Added a ModelOpt-compatible MXFP8 path for MiniMax-M3. With --kv-cache-dtype fp8, MSA and index caches use native FP8 E4M3 while dense GQA layers use BF16 unless explicitly configured otherwise. #14412 #15897 #15926
  • Added DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark on 950DT Products, including DSA-CP integration and SparseFlashMla-based BF16 KV sparse attention. #13249 #13506 #13716
  • Added DeepSeek-V4-Flash layerwise KV-cache reuse support for physical layers with multiple main cache specifications. #17081
  • Integrated vLLM StartPlan so repeat startups can reuse measured KV-cache budgets and graph-capture results. #15654
  • Integrated the GMM-SiTU operator for supported MoE paths. #15871

Hardware and Operator Support

Model Supported hardware in v0.27.1rc1 Release scope
MiniMax-M3 Atlas 800 A3 and 950DT Products W8A8 on Atlas 800 A3 and W8A8C8 on 950DT Products; two-node 1P1D serving and KV Cache Pool deployment
DeepSeek-V4-Flash 950DT Products W4A8C8; two-node 1P1D DSpark serving and KV Cache Pool deployment
  • Integrated the AscendC MSA index-score operator into MiniMax-M3 prefill, decode, and speculative-decode paths. #14539
  • Added the MiniMax-M3 950DT Products FP8 MSA and index top-k path, including the release-branch AscendC FP8 MSA index-score backport. #15897 #15926
  • Added native non-power-of-two MLA head support without Q-head padding or output slicing. #15882
  • Integrated GMM-SiTU for supported MoE paths. #15871

Performance

Unless stated otherwise, these optimizations are selected automatically for the targeted path and need no additional configuration.

  • Optimized MiniMax-M3 MSA index-score computation for prefill, decode, and speculative decode. #14539
  • Reworked MiniMax-M3 decode score computation and TP communication to exchange index queries and local top-k candidates instead of full index KV data. #13142
  • Reduced the MiniMax-M3 sparse-attention score operator cost and added FlashDecoding support. #13987
  • Overlapped shared-expert input/output collectives and projections with routed-expert computation in the supported MoE multistream path. #15974
  • Built DeepSeek V4 compressor, indexer, sparse-attention, and DSpark metadata asynchronously on eligible Model Runner V1 paths. #15776
  • Improved DeepSeek V4 DSA-CP prefill execution by aligning sequence parallelism with the model and attention collectives. #16021
  • Prefetched two AscendStore layers by default to reduce layerwise KV Pool stalls. #15797

Dependencies

Use the official v0.27.1rc1 release images to ensure that the required operator packages and matching dependency versions are installed.

  • Upstream vLLM: v0.27.1.
  • Python: >= 3.10, < 3.13; the release images use Python 3.12.
  • Ascend HDK: 26.1.1.
  • CANN: 9.1.0.
  • PTA (PyTorch / torch_npu): 2.10.0 / 2.10.0.post4.
  • Triton Ascend: 3.2.2.
  • Mooncake: 0.3.11.post1 in the release images.

Deprecation and Configuration Changes

  • The parameters enable_sparse_sfa_c8 and enable_sparse_li_c8 will be deprecated in a future release. For KV cache quantization, we have aligned the configuration approach with the upstream community. Use --kv-cache-dtype and --attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype to specify quantization types.
  • Upcoming model deprecations: The following models are planned for deprecation from the actively maintained model set. Once this takes effect, their CI and nightly test coverage will no longer be maintained, and the latest main branch will no longer receive model-specific compatibility fixes or feature maintenance for them. This does not affect their availability in the earlier releases and release candidates that include them, where they received extensive functional and performance validation. Users can continue deploying those versions and use them as a base for custom development and model-specific extensions:
    • DeepSeek-R1
    • DeepSeek-R1-0528
    • DeepSeek-V3.1
    • DeepSeek-V3.2
    • GLM-4.7
    • GLM-5
    • Hy3-preview
    • Kimi-K2-Thinking
    • Kimi-K2.5
    • MiniMax-M2.5
    • MiniMax-M2.7
    • Qwen3-235B-A22B
    • Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct
    • QwQ-32B
  • Enabling additional_config.enable_dsa_cp now emits an advance deprecation warning. Starting with v0.29.0, DSA-CP will be deprecated for Model Runner V2 deployments; Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP) will provide full coverage and replace it. The Model Runner V1 path will remain available until Model Runner V1 is removed, after which DSA-CP will be removed completely. DSA-CP behavior is unchanged in v0.27.1rc1. #15890
  • finegrained_tp_config.olora_tensor_parallel_size is deprecated in the v0.27.x release line and has already been removed from main; it will be unavailable starting with the v0.28.x release line. Remove this key before upgrading. This only removes the unused DeepSeek V4 oLoRA tensor-parallel switch; the model architecture field o_lora_rank, standard LoRA adapters, and the other fine-grained TP settings are unaffected. #15857
  • For v0.27.1rc1, release images do not preload jemalloc globally. This is a release-specific image configuration and does not announce removal in future releases; jemalloc remains installed and can be enabled explicitly when required. #17146

Documentation

  • Expanded the MiniMax-M3 guide with Atlas 800 A3 and 950DT Products standalone and P/D-disaggregated deployment, EAGLE3, KV Cache Pool, chunked prefill, Prefix Cache, multimodal, reasoning, and tool-calling guidance. #13476 #16173 #16509 #16987 #17242
  • Added 950DT Products model-matrix coverage and deployment guidance for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. #17435

Stability and Bug Fixes

  • Corrected parallel-drafting sequence lengths and draft-model detection, handled empty DSpark context, skipped over-limit drafting without breaking DP collective alignment, and preserved tensor state for the following asynchronous step. #15870 #15977 #16720 #16513 #17276
  • Fixed out-of-bounds rejection-sampling address construction and reject invalid stop_token_ids or allowed_token_ids before device-side indexing. #16215 #16161
  • Fixed DeepSeek V4 chat-template rendering, reasoning-effort compatibility, long tool-argument streaming, DSpark draft attn_sink loading under DSA-CP with TP > 1, DSA-CP sequence-parallel execution, and a DSA-CP hang caused by stale host-side QLI bounds. #16115 #15422 #16021 #16480
  • Fixed MiniMax-M3 prefill top-k score preparation and 950DT Products FP8 MSA index-score integration. #16122 #15926
  • Preserved hybrid cache layouts for speculative draft configurations and corrected P/D recompute request classification on decode workers. #15907 #16435
  • Fixed AscendStore hybrid Mamba cache release and TP-mismatch transfer routing, and synchronized eager MemCache initialization across DP workers. #15763 #16101 #17308

Known Issues

  • This is a model-focused release candidate. Only the model and hardware combinations in the table above are included in the v0.27.1rc1 release scope.
  • MiniMax-M3 EAGLE3 uses eager execution for the draft model in the validated P/D configurations; follow the updated deployment guide. #17242

entry.title: [v0.26.0rc2][BugFix][SpecDecode] Handle empty DSpark context (#16712)
entry.content:
What this PR does / why we need it?

Backport commit 1889ebe to
rfc/0.26.0rc1-bugfix.

When a speculative row has no retained context, the shared DFlash/DSpark
input kernel reads a position before that request's range. Derive query
positions from the request's original first position in this case,
preserving the existing behavior for nonempty context.

Resolve the backport conflicts against the release branch's
copy_and_expand_dflash_and_dspark_inputs_kernel_single_grid; adapt the
operator tests to that interface without importing main's vectorized
kernel changes.

Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

Prevents invalid position reads for empty retained context. No
configuration or API changes. This patch does not establish the
scheduler-side cause of a discarded speculative row.

How was this patch tested?

  • All 21 operator cases passed on an Ascend NPU in vllm_0914, using an
    isolated copy of the backported kernel and test module, without
    replacing installed source. Includes first, middle and last empty rows,
    both position dtypes and both sampling modes, plus normal-context cases.

  • Ruff lint, Ruff format check, Python compilation and git diff --check passed for the changed files.

  • Full bash format.sh ci could not complete locally: pre-commit
    stalled while installing its markdownlint environment. Full repository
    CI remains pending.
